subject: Class of 2016 Final Mustang Report
overview: The final Mustang Report of the school year featured student projects from the Bloomberg Fair and CCSR, followed by farewell messages and college announcements from graduating seniors.

items.title: Opening Skit
items.summary: Students performed a parody search for staff and facilities around the high school campus.

items.title: Mustang Report Question of the Week
items.summary: The program announced the answer to the previous weekly question and posed a final inquiry regarding the size of the 2016 graduating class.

items.title: Bloomberg Fair
items.summary: Mr. Skorka explained that the fair showcases student organizations and activities that receive support from Bloomberg funds.

items.title: Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility Projects
items.summary: Students presented CCSR initiatives including a financial literacy curriculum for high schoolers, a museum docent program, and the installation of buddy benches on playgrounds.

items.title: Senior Farewell and Future Plans
items.summary: Graduating seniors thanked the media technology department and announced their upcoming college destinations and intended majors.

items.title: Headmaster's Closing Remarks
items.summary: Dr. John Perella commended the Mustang Report staff for their dedication to documenting school events throughout the academic year.
